calls.reason: Almost all of the move is company-specific. RVTY rose 9.95% on its own (4.4σ) on 2.6x normal volume, after an earnings release (filing items 2.02 and 8.01), while the market and sector were flat. A clean earnings gap to a new 52-week high with strong 12-1 momentum fits post-earnings drift. The offsets are a stock already up 103% from its low, an extended price (49% above the 200-day average), and weakening credit. That makes this a modest edge over the roughly 50% base rate, not a strong one.

For ADM that most likely means weaker crush or processing margins and a lower outlook, and analysts usually revise estimates down over several weeks. The base rate leans slightly to underperformance. A 27% one-month lag versus the sector and a strong XLP raise the odds of a bounce, so I keep conviction close to 50%.

That makes some profit-taking likely and limits the edge to a modest tilt above the roughly 50% base rate.

This is purely a company move: a 14% idiosyncratic jump (6.4σ) on an earnings release with 4.8x volume, while the sector fell. For a stock that reset guidance and has lagged badly (12-1 momentum −31%, 16% below its high), a strong print likely signals the turnaround is working. Underweight investors may keep buying after a big surprise, which supports modest outperformance over 20 days. Risks: profit-taking after a 27% one-month run, and widening credit spreads.
